items.title: Volume,capacity and units are different claims
items.student: Compare area(cm²),geometric volume(cm³)and usable container capacity(mL/L). Convert2500cm³toL,0.75Ltocm³and0.002m³toL. Explain why1m³is1000000cm³rather than100cm³,and why exterior volume need not equal usable capacity.

items.title: Same base and height:why the cone is one-third
items.student: Use rightcone/cylindermodels withradius3cm,verticalheight4cm(coneslant5cm). Calculate volumes and ratio. If teacher supplies matched watertight safe plastic apparatus,perform a supervised clean-water capacity comparison with a measuringcylinder/tray;record actualmeasuredinternaldimensions/volumes and namedpour/record/checkactions. If unavailable,use geometricmodels and mark actualcapacitycomparison NOTOBSERVED. Never pour water into paperprojectmodels.

items.title: Pyramid volume uses vertical height
items.student: Right square pyramid:base4cm by4cm,verticalheight3cm. Determine volume and idealzero-wallcapacity in mL. A right rectangularpyramid base6cm by8cm,height5cm:repeat. Explain why face slantheight cannot replace h.

items.title: Cone frustum from similar cones
items.student: Rightcone-frustum:R5cm,r3cm,verticalheight4cm. Extend slant lines to a common apex;similar-coneheights satisfyHsmall/Hlarge=3/5andHlarge-Hsmall=4. Find both heights,subtract cone volumes and compare withV=(πh/3)(R²+Rr+r²).

items.title: Measure an actual tapered container honestly
items.student: Teacher supplies a clean safe empty plastic container approximating a rightcircularcone-frustum. Measure internal top/bottomdiameters and perpendicular usabledepth with approved ruler/caliper;repeat and record actual readings/toolprecision. Compute an idealcapacity estimate and state wall/taper/rounding/freeboard limits. If shape/interioraccess uncertain,record what is unmeasured instead of forcing a frustum. Separateexactpractice:topdiam10cm,bottomdiam6cm,height12cm.

items.title: Pyramid-frustum formula needs similar parallel ends
items.student: For a right square-pyramidfrustum:bottomside4cm,topside2cm,verticalheight3cm,useV=h/3*(A1+A2+sqrt(A1A2)). Derive by subtracting similarpyramids if possible. Repeat for a rectangularpyramidfrustum:bottom4cm×6cm,top2cm×3cm,height5cm. Explain why arbitrary unrelatedtop/bottomshapes do not satisfy this formula.

items.title: Make different-size cone and pyramid containers
items.student: Classgroupsmake two sizes of each using clean card/tape and teacher-approved templates. Cone1:r3,h4,slant5cm,sectorradius5/angle216°;Cone2:r1.5,h2,slant2.5,angle216°. Squarepyramid1:baseside4,h3,faceheight√13;Pyramid2:baseside2,h1.5,faceheight√13/2. Use centralbase/fouroutwardtrianglesforpyramids;orientopenbasemodelasvessel if desired. Record actualdimensions,constructedfeatures and each namedcontribution. Paper is a geometric model,notwatertight usablecontainer.

items.title: Make different-size frustum containers
items.student: Classgroupsmake both cone- and squarepyramid-frustummodels in two sizes. Conefrustum1:R3,r1.5,verticalh2,slant2.5cm:annularsectorouterradius5,inner2.5,angle216°;half-sizeversionhalvesalllengths/sameangle. Squarepyramidfrustum1:bottomside4,topside2,verticalh3,faceheight√10;half-sizeversionbottom2,top1,h1.5,faceheight√10/2. Add/removetops/bottoms tolabelidealinterior volume. Recordactualnamedconstruction/measure/checkcontributions;no waterinpaper.

items.title: Document the actual process with pictures and video
items.student: Using teacher-approved device/local storage,capture object-only stillpictures and a shortvideo clip showing an actual model-making/check process;include scale/label/context and each namedlearnercontribution. Save with modelID/date/units and add one actualmeasurement/challenge note. No faces,personaldata,accounts,uploads or externalpublication required. If deviceaccessunavailable,retain datedpaperprocessrecord but mark photo/video actionsNOTOBSERVED and arrange later opportunity.
items.teacher: Requireactualstillcapture,actualvideocaptureandlocal save/retrieval/checkactions;printedintention/photosfromelsewherecannotcertify. Teacherapprovespermissions/storageandobservesnamedactions whilekeeping model/capacityclaimsaccurate. Sourceprojectrequests pictures AND video,different-sizecone/pyramid/frustums notonegenericdrawing. Wholeclassartifactdoesnotproveeverylearnerdidallsteps.

items.title: Use capacity with a stated usable fill
items.student: Fictionalinternalfrustumcontainer topR5cm,bottomr3cm,height12cm. Calculate fullidealcapacity and90%usablefillvolume. With idealconstantfillflow100mL/min,findtimeforusablefill. Explain assumptions and why freeboard,variableflow,wallshape and uncertainmeasurementslimitrealresults. Give one useful volume/capacityapplicationwithbenefit/limit.
